assumptions.histogram_boundaries: native cumulative/rolling metrics are not fully isolated to a single load level; see per-run evidence_windows
assumptions.latency_distributions: only p50/p95/p99 quantiles are collected; raw histogram bucket distributions are not preserved
assumptions.sole_traffic: detection heuristic only (environment.sole_traffic_invariant per run); external traffic is not proven absent

limitations: the sweep verdict is INCONCLUSIVE: saturation is not demonstrated (see summary.caveats)

runtime_config.note: read-only /runtime/config readbacks at level boundaries; the sweep never mutates policy

evidence_windows.counter_deltas: cumulative counters delta'd from the post-warmup poll to the final poll (warmup and drain excluded)
evidence_windows.execution_evidence: native request-histogram delta over the per-run collector rolling window (window_s=5.0) ending at the final poll; the cumulative baseline is taken post-warmup, so warmup observations are excluded
evidence_windows.final_poll: the final measurement poll occurs BEFORE phase-end drain begins, so drain completions are not in the histograms or counters; it can include a few milliseconds of post-t1 measurement traffic
evidence_windows.normalized_metrics: median over telemetry polls in [t_start + window_s, t_end] (measurement ramp-in excluded)
evidence_windows.note: Cumulative/rolling native metrics are NOT fully isolated to a single load level; the intervals above are the actual observation windows.
evidence_windows.output_tokens_per_s: generation-token counter delta over [post-warmup poll, final poll] (~15.012s) / that window; warmup and post-measurement drain excluded
evidence_windows.throughput_req_s: measurement-period completions / actual measurement span; post-measurement drain excluded
